# sendgrid_segment (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid Marketing Campaigns contact segment by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_segment" "active_customers" {
  id = "199abb98-0af3-4a8d-b371-6811ff85d062"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The segment's UUID.

### Read-Only

- `contacts_count` (Number) The number of contacts currently matching this segment.
- `name` (String) The segment's name.
- `parent_list_ids` (List of String) Restricts this segment to contacts on these list IDs.
- `query_dsl` (String) The SQL-like query used to filter contacts into this segment.
